name: EaseGen
tagline: AI video and image generation with creative tools for visual storytelling
description: EaseGen is an AI video and image generator for creating and developing visual concepts. It supports image-to-video and text-to-video generation with 30+ models. Viral Trends frequently adds popular TikTok AI video formats, including AI Hotel Lobby and AI Tiny Desk, so creators can explore current short-form styles. Downloads are watermark-free. Canvas helps organize images and videos while developing visual ideas. AI Story can turn an idea or script into a storyboard with visual references and clips, helping structure a concept before creating or assembling content. EaseGen is a freemium product.
